connector.name: Uphealth Signal
connector.registryDescription: The adaptive health-messaging engine for apps and agents. Federally-sourced. Not medical advice.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.uphealth.us over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace us.uphealth, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Keyless by default — lookup_health_fact needs no token. Add 'Bearer up_sandbox_...' to unlock the keyed patient-stream + cue tools; get a free key from https://uphealth.us/signup to start.

env.name: UPHEALTH_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Runs keyless by default — lookup_health_fact needs no key. Get a free sandbox key (it begins up_sandbox_) from https://uphealth.us/signup to unlock the keyed patient-stream + cue tools.
